page.layout: One page of text, single column; in the left margin, beside the lines "Si autem materia", a marginal note block "Gal. lib. 7. & 11. Metho."; running head at top centre; page number top left.

main_text.p: tenuantibus crassam, initio mitioribus, qua-lia sunt mel rosatū, syrup. glycyrrhizæ cum duplo aquæ saluiæ, hyssopi, vel decoctipecto-ralis ex glycyrrhiza, vuis passis, myxis, zi-ziphis, & similibus compositi: sed proceden-te affectu valentius incidentia & tenuantia vtenda, & primò mitiora: vt syrup. de dua-bus radicibus: post efficaciora: vt, syrup. de hyssopo, de prassio, tandem syrup. de stœcha de cū aqua saluiæ, hyssopi, bethonicæ, vel po-tius decocto pectorali cum ficis, passis, gly-cyrrhiza, adianto, præsertim sisputum pro-mouere libet.

Si autem materia est lenta, & glutinosa, oxymeli simplex & compositum. Nam bilis flauæ vacuatio est facilis: pituitæ verò præ-sertim crassæ & lentæ etiam à ventriculo, difficilis sine incisione, & detersione: atræ bi-lis difficilior.
3. PVRGANTIBVS materiam, calidam quidem: vt, pilulis aureis, agoregatiuis, à drachma vna ad scriptula quatuor, electa-rio ex succo rosarum, rosato, diapruno scam-moniato,

page.notes: <note side="left">Gal. lib. 7. & 11. Metho.</note> Catchword and signature not printed. Page is 216, running head CATARRHI. Some words in the lower block are faint; "agoregatiuis" and "electa-rio" read as printed.
